correctness.rationale: Induction on modal depth over finite atom/agent sets bounds depth-0 types by 2^k and each depth-r+1 type by its valuation and the sets of depth-r successor types per agent, giving N_(r+1)=2^(k+m N_r). Each admissible epistemic announcement of depth<=d is globally determined by one of at most N_d types, yielding at most 2^N_d globally distinct truth sets. Choose representatives only of definable classes and replace each bounded quantifier by a finite conjunction [psi]phi. Global equivalence preserves the full updated model, including when quantifiers nest and updates restrict accessibility. Translate PAL to base S5 epistemic logic, which has FMP; equivalence transfers a finite S5 model to the bounded formula. Boundary d=0, empty agent set and empty atom set are covered by the recurrence.
